commands:
systemd-run --expand-environment=no --unit=borsuk-rust-replay-s3-panel32 --wait --pipe -p WorkingDirectory="$root" -p CPUQuota=100% -p CPUQuotaPeriodSec=100ms -p AllowedCPUs=0 -p MemoryMax=512M -p MemorySwapMax=0 -p TasksMax=128 -p KillMode=control-group -p TimeoutStopSec=30 -p RuntimeMaxSec="$(( left + 120 ))" --setenv=RUSTUP_HOME="$root/.rustup" --setenv=CARGO_HOME="$root/.cargo" --setenv=PATH="$root/.cargo/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin" /bin/bash -c 'set -euo pipefail
trap '\''exit 97'\'' TERM HUP INT
root=/mnt/borsuk-scale1m
ev="$root/evidence/s3-panel32"
cg=$(awk -F: '\''$1==0 {print $3}'\'' /proc/self/cgroup)
printf "%s\n" "$cg" > "$ev/cgroup-path.txt"
for f in cpu.max cpuset.cpus.effective memory.max memory.swap.max pids.max; do cat "/sys/fs/cgroup$cg/$f" > "$ev/$f.before"; done
test "$(cat "$ev/cpu.max.before")" = "100000 100000"
test "$(cat "$ev/cpuset.cpus.effective.before")" = 0
test "$(cat "$ev/memory.max.before")" = 536870912
test "$(cat "$ev/memory.swap.max.before")" = 0
test "$(cat "$ev/pids.max.before")" = 128
left=$(( $(cat "$root/gate-deadline.epoch") - $(date +%s) ))
(( left > 30 )) || exit 124
(( left <= 900 )) || left=900
printf "%s\n" '\''/mnt/borsuk-scale1m/bin/check_cohere_native_baseline /mnt/borsuk-scale1m/closed/s3/panel32-config.json d75b5834ab5132c711d415ff8bc6321b47fb75a6513513ab66d853daada98c4d /mnt/borsuk-scale1m/closed/s3/panel32-result.jsonl'\'' > "$ev/native-command.txt"
printf "%s  %s\n" 59fe47aa1001b3ca24d1f9ff31444f97fcda72e3e297c8d7d846f5c3d811bfc3 "$root/bin/check_cohere_native_baseline" | sha256sum -c - > "$ev/release-before.log"
date -u +%FT%TZ > "$ev/native-started.txt"
set +e
/usr/bin/time -v -o "$ev/native-time.txt" timeout --kill-after=30 "$left" /mnt/borsuk-scale1m/bin/check_cohere_native_baseline /mnt/borsuk-scale1m/closed/s3/panel32-config.json d75b5834ab5132c711d415ff8bc6321b47fb75a6513513ab66d853daada98c4d /mnt/borsuk-scale1m/closed/s3/panel32-result.jsonl > "$ev/native.log" 2>&1
status=$?
set -e
printf "%s\n" "$status" > "$ev/native-exit.txt"
date -u +%FT%TZ > "$ev/native-finished.txt"
for f in memory.peak memory.events memory.swap.peak pids.peak cpu.stat; do if test -f "/sys/fs/cgroup$cg/$f"; then cat "/sys/fs/cgroup$cg/$f" > "$ev/$f.after"; fi; done
exit "$status"' > "$ev/systemd-run.log" 2>&1

timeout --kill-after=2 10 systemctl show borsuk-rust-replay-s3-panel32.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p Result -p ExecMainCode -p ExecMainStatus -p ControlGroup > "$ev/systemd-after.txt" 2> "$ev/systemd-after.stderr"

if test -s "$ev/cgroup-path.txt"; then cg=$(cat "$ev/cgroup-path.txt"); if [[ "$cg" == "/system.slice/borsuk-rust-replay-s3-panel32.service" ]]; then if test ! -d "/sys/fs/cgroup$cg"; then drained=true; elif grep -qx "populated 0" "/sys/fs/cgroup$cg/cgroup.events"; then drained=true; fi; fi; fi
native=null; if test -s "$ev/native-exit.txt"; then native=$(cat "$ev/native-exit.txt"); [[ "$native" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || native=null; fi

jq -n --arg schema borsuk-full1000-rust-replay-stage-v1 --arg stage 's3-panel32' --arg source c3e52c8bbf0fcc985c0a8a06d2abeec5d7442d38 --argjson manager "$manager" --argjson native "$native" --argjson drained "$drained" '{schema:$schema,stage:$stage,source_commit:$source,manager_exit:$manager,native_exit:$native,owned_cgroup_drained:$drained,performance_claim:false}' > "$ev/terminal.json"
(cd "$ev" && find . -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum) > "$ev/SHA256SUMS"

for file in "$ev"/*; do remaining=$(( publication_deadline - $(date +%s) - 2 )); (( remaining > 0 )) || exit 124; (( remaining <= 90 )) || remaining=90; timeout --kill-after=2 "$remaining" aws s3api put-object --bucket borsuk-bench-453182569524-euc1 --key research/semantic-router/20261011/full1000-rust-replay-a0003/stages/s3-panel32/"$(basename "$file")" --body "$file" --if-none-match "*" > /dev/null; done
